entry.title: New: RES23-228 (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
URGING CITY AGENCIES DESIGNATED TO ENFORCE THE CITY’S BUILDING, FIRE, AND ZONING CODES TO WORK WITH THE HONOLULU POLICE DEPARTMENT IN THE GATHERING OF EVIDENCE AND SERVING OF NOTICES OF VIOLATION FOR BUILDING CODE, FIRE CODE, AND LAND USE ORDINANCE VIOLATIONS FOR PROPERTIES ON WHICH ILLEGAL GAME ROOMS ARE SITUATED.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.5 which sets a one-year filing period on pending resolutions.
